name: Being In Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that being in Christ is a transformative relationship granted to those who receive and believe in Him, giving them the right to become children of God (John 1:12). This union is symbolized through baptism, which identifies believers with Christ's death and resurrection, enabling them to walk in newness of life (Romans 6:3-4; Acts 2:38). Furthermore, those who are in Christ experience freedom from condemnation as they live by the Spirit rather than the flesh (Romans 8:1), reflecting the vital connection to Christ as the true vine sustained by the Father (John 15:1).
